privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.intro: Reel Studio is a small invite-only beta. This page says what we keep, for how long, who handles it and how to delete it.
stored: The clips and photos you upload, and the working files made from them while we edit.
The two finished Reels, the caption and the notes on the result page.
Your order: the style and wishes you chose, your note, your email address, the invite code you used, your rating and comment, and the times each step happened.
howLong: Your uploaded clips and the working files: 7 days.
The finished Reels and your order: 30 days.
processors: Anthropic (Claude) looks at still frames and transcripts of your clips to plan the edit.
Google runs the website and stores the files (Google Cloud), and transcribes speech when you keep the voice (Gemini).
Stripe shows the checkout page and keeps your email address with the payment record.
privacy.cookies: No cookies, no analytics scripts and no tracking pixels.
privacy.delete: Open the link in your email and press "Delete my files now" on the result page. It removes your clips and Reels at once. To remove everything else sooner, ask Kevin.
